title: Overdue invoice reminders
body:
# Overdue invoice reminders

## Objectives
- **O1.** Customers are nudged about an overdue invoice before it goes to collections.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1.** A reminder email is sent when an invoice is 14 days past due. *Verified by: manual check.*
- **AC2.** A reminder is never sent for an invoice that has been paid. *Verified by: manual check.*
